messages:
Samir: quick flag  onboarding metrics dashboard showing sudden drop in 'first-week-activation' for new trials since 03:00 UTC.
Tessa: I see it too, cohort 2025-07-18 has activation 18% vs baseline 42%. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/onboard-activation
Rohit: any infra deploys around that time?
Samir: nothing in infra, but a playbook change merged last night adjusted the 'welcome_email' cadence from 24h -> 48h for low-touch accounts. commit: 4b7c1d.
Claire: could delaying welcome email cause the drop? probably a contributor. Also noticed CRM sync lag spikes at same time.
cs-ops-bot: ALERT: ONBOARD_ACTIVATION_DROP #3619876543 severity=medium; metric=first_week_activation; delta=-24pp
Tessa: plan proposal: 1) revert welcome_email cadence to 24h for new trials 2) investigate CRM sync lag root cause 3) run a targeted catch-up email for cohorts impacted 4) add canary check for onboarding engagement before cadence changes.
Rohit: I'll revert cadence PR and add a feature flag so we can canary.
Samir: I'll investigate CRM sync: `select max(latency_ms) from crm_sync where ts between '2025-07-18T02:30' and '2025-07-18T04:30'` and check connector errors.
Claire: for catch-up email, ensure we don't double-send to accounts that later self-activate; use event filter: send only if activated_at is NULL and received_welcome = false.
Rohit: revert merged to staging, deploying canary now. Also adding metric test that simulates a 10k-user small-run and checks activation signal.
cs-ops-bot: canary deploy started by Rohit; target=staging.
Samir: CRM sync logs show 15 minute window with failed webhook retries to provider X; error 502 from connector. latency peaked at 8s per request.
Tessa: connector team rollbacked a provider change at 03:45 UTC, that aligns. They say the downstream provider throttled and sent 502s.
Claire: ok risk: if we immediately send catch-up emails while provider still flaky, playbook will create more retries. we should coordinate timing.
Rohit: canary passed in staging. I'll promote to prod but with feature flag off for low-touch cohort until we validate catch-up plan.
Samir: exported affected cohort list: 1,324 trial accounts created between 02:45-03:30 UTC. will provide CSV.
Claire: drafting catch-up email template: "Hi <name> — welcome! We noticed you haven't completed setup. Quick steps: <link>. Expect one automated reminder." Include suppression token.
Tessa: owners: we should DM AMs for accounts with ARR > 10k (about 14 accounts). I'll create AM ping with link.
cs-ops-bot: feature-flag update: onboarding.cadence.welcome_email=24h (canary=false) recorded by Rohit.
Rohit: prod revert completed, cadence restored for all cohorts.
Samir: connector team confirmed provider recovered and webhooks resumed at 04:10 UTC; replayed failed webhooks and sync backlog processed.
Claire: scheduling catch-up job in 30m with suppression rules: only send if activated_at IS NULL and last_email_sent > 72h OR never. Also cap to 2 emails per account.
Tessa: running dry-run of catch-up: would send 1,102 emails; 14 flagged accounts will get AM DM.
Samir: after catch-up dry-run, activation rate on a staging sample looked promising (from 18% -> 40%).
Rohit: follow-ups: 1) add deploy-gate that warns if playbook or cadence changes overlap with connector/provider maintenance windows 2) add canary engagement simulation for onboarding cadence changes 3) add alert if first_week_activation deviates >10pp in 1h. I'll own 1+2.
Claire: I'll own the catch-up run and AM notifications. Tessa will draft the postmortem and outreach logs.
cs-ops-bot: catch-up job executed id=cup-361987; emails_sent=1102; flagged_AMs_notified=14.
Tessa: AM replies trickling in, one requests personalized note for their account, done. No customer escalations so far.
Samir: good recovery. postmortem draft will include timeline, root cause (provider throttling + cadence change timing), and remediation (deploy gate + canary + owner pings).
Claire: adding note to onboarding-runbook: always check connector health before global cadence changes.
Rohit: closing deploy ticket. thanks team. :thumbsup:
